RICHARD F. ARNETT Richard Fulton Arnett, 43, of Ave. L, Yucaipa, died Saturday in Welton, Ariz. A native of Oxnard, Arnett had lived in Yucaipa 20 years. He was a past member of, the VFW in Yucaipa, and worked as a laborer. He nad lived in San Bernardino from 1918 to 1932. Survivors include the widow, Andree, of Yucaipa; four brothers, Phillip of San Bernardino, Bruce of Yucaipa, Harold of Ventura and Clyde of Arizona, and two sisters, Elsie Morris of Seattle and Mrs. Ruby Arends of Whittier. Funeral services will be at 8 p.m. Thursday in Mark B. Shaw Chapel. Interment will be at ll a.m. Friday in Ivy Lawn Cemeterv. Ventura.
